source: real run records written by the Control Plane's own flows (tests/test_freshness.py, tests/test_operation_identity.py, tests/test_rule_revision.py, tests/test_merge_record.py, tests/test_reversibility.py and tests/test_dedupe.py helpers: synthetic proposals, a settable service clock, throwaway stores); nothing hand-edited

producer.note: main after N4 (#54), the 0.1/0.2 reason registry split (#55), F1 (#50-#53), strict JSON J3 (#56), input validation hardening with the opt-in terminal-revocation/0.1 profile and registry 0.2 code grant_revocation_recorded (#58), and strict instant parsing (#59); contains everything the earlier captures at 3755c71a and 128eaa5e had

scripts.provenance/capture_programme2.py: the N1/N2/N3 scenarios (the 20 scenarios of the earlier capture, re-run unchanged at the new revision)
scripts.provenance/capture_n4.py: the N4 scenarios (merge, reversibility, dedupe) and the terminal-revocation scenario; the dedupe escalation pass is taken at 301 s, not 300 s, because the escalation deadline is inclusive since 3cd17ead (the only change to a script's behaviour since 3755c71a)

run: from a control plane checkout at the revision above: PYTHONPATH=src:. python <script> <out-dir>
randomness: decision, attempt, check, join, renewal, refusal and run ids and nonces are random uuids; a re-capture differs in those and nowhere else (the clock is fixed)
earlier_capture: The 20 N1/N2/N3 fixtures were first captured at 128eaa5e (Replay 8e32975d), re-captured at 3755c71a (Replay 3c056cf8) and now at 3cd17ead. Documents differ from the 3755c71a capture only in random ids, nonces and commit strings; the registry labels are unchanged (six freshness fixtures carry runtime-authority-reasons/0.2).
script_note: capture_programme2.py code unchanged since 128eaa5e (only its docstring revision text moved). capture_n4.py: dedupe escalation pass at 301 s (was 300 s) and the terminal-revocation scenario added (it must run first: a later scenario leaves module state that makes the terminal flow's manifest digest mismatch); the other scenarios are unchanged.
